He played [[college basketball]] for the [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina Gamecocks]] and the [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence Friars]]. ==Early life and high school career== Carter initially attended [[Cherry Creek High School]] in [[Greenwood Village, Colorado]]. He transferred to [[Doral Academy Preparatory School]] in [[Doral, Florida]], after his freshman year, when his family relocated to Florida following his father, [[Anthony Carter (basketball)|Anthony Carter]], being hired as a player development coach for the [[Miami Heat]].{{cite web|url=https://www.thestate.com/sports/college/university-of-south-carolina/usc-recruiting/phil-kornblut/article242239816.html|title=Basketball recruiting: South Carolina could land Devin Carter|work=[[The State (newspaper)|The State]]|date=April 23, 2020|access-date=February 14, 2024}} Carter's senior season was cut short due to a shoulder injury, and he opted to enroll at [[Brewster Academy]] in [[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]], for a [[postgraduate year]].{{cite web|url=https://southcarolina.rivals.com/news/after-reclassifying-to-be-a-gamecock-carter-showing-potential-as-freshman|title=After reclassifying to be a Gamecock, Carter showing potential as freshman|first=Collyn|last=Taylor|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=January 28, 2022|access-date=February 20, 2024}} Carter was rated a three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to playing college basketball for [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]] during his senior year at Doral Academy.{{cite web|url=https://southcarolina.rivals.com/news/gamecocks-land-commitment-from-high-scoring-guard|title=Gamecocks land commitment from high-scoring guard|first=Collyn|last=Taylor|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=April 24, 2020|access-date=February 14, 2024}} ==College career== Carter began his college career at [[South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball|South Carolina]]. He played in 30 games during his freshman season and averaged nine points and 3.8 rebounds per game. Following the end of the season, Carter entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|url=https://www.thestate.com/sports/college/university-of-south-carolina/usc-mens-basketball/article259852865.html|title=South Carolina basketball: Devin Carter in transfer portal|work=[[The State (newspaper)|The State]]|date=March 28, 2022|access-date=February 14, 2024}} Carter transferred to Providence.{{cite web|url=https://www.providencejournal.com/story/sports/college/2022/04/17/south-carolina-shooting-guard-devin-carter-and-la-salle-big-man-clifton-moore-jr-both-committed-the/7350509001/|title=Two transfers — South Carolina's Devin Carter and La Salle's Clifton Moore Jr. — commit to PC|first=Bill|last=Koch|work=[[The Providence Journal]]|date=April 17, 2022|access-date=February 14, 2024}} He averaged 13 points and 4.9 rebounds in his first season with the Friars.{{cite web|url=https://www.providencejournal.com/story/sports/college/2023/03/31/providence-basketballs-bryce-hopkins-devin-carter-to-remain-friars/70068886007/|title=Providence basketball stars Bryce Hopkins, Devin Carter will remain Friars|work=[[The Providence Journal]]|date=March 31, 2023|access-date=February 14, 2024}} In his second season, he won both Big East First Team and [[Big East Player
